evals.prompt: Create a zettelkasten note about the concept of 'Deliberate Practice' sourced from the book 'Peak - Anders Ericsson'. It should reference a highlight with block ID ref-442891 from the highlights note, link to the Learning map, and include a flashcard section.
evals.expected_output: A valid .md file with correct frontmatter (emoji tags, wiki-linked dates, parent/related/referenced-in properties), wikilinks with display text, a footnote that embeds a block reference from highlights, and a Flashcards heading.
expectations: Frontmatter uses wiki-linked date format for create-date: "[[YYYY-MM-DD]]"
Tags use emoji format in a YAML list: 📖 and ♣️
parent property references the book with wiki-link syntax: "[[Peak - Anders Ericsson]]"
related property links to the Learning map: "[[Learning]]"
referenced-in property links to the highlights note
Body uses wikilinks with display text for linking to other concepts
Footnote uses embed syntax to cite a ^ref- block ID from highlights
Contains # Flashcards heading
append_modified_update is set to true
No Templater syntax appears in the output (this is a rendered note, not a template)

evals.prompt: I have a map of content note and I need to add a new Dataview section that shows all people notes related to this map. Show me what the section should look like, using the same patterns as existing map sections.
evals.expected_output: A new section with a callout wrapper and a Dataview query block that queries #🙂 notes filtered by related/parent containing this.file.link, matching the established map template pattern.
expectations: Uses a callout with collapse syntax (> [!type]- or > [!type]+)
Dataview query is inside a ```dataview fenced code block
Query uses TABLE WITHOUT ID format
Query uses FROM #🙂 to filter people notes
Query uses WHERE contains(related, this.file.link) or contains(parent, this.file.link)
Query includes SORT clause
The Dataview block is syntactically valid (proper field separators, no missing keywords)

evals.prompt: Create a daily journal note for 2025-05-21 with a habits tracker table inside a callout and navigation links to previous/next days.
evals.expected_output: A daily note with correct frontmatter (📅 tag, before/after navigation, parent linking to weekly), habits using Dataview inline fields inside a callout with a table.
expectations: Frontmatter has tags: [📅]
before and after properties use wiki-linked dates for adjacent days
parent property links to the weekly note in wiki-link format
Habits section uses Dataview inline field syntax: (FieldName::value)
Inline fields are inside a callout block (> [!type])
No Templater syntax in the output — this is a rendered note
